query:
SELECT 
  m.attendeeId,
  m.sponsorId,
  COUNT(*) as meetingCount,
  s.companyName as sponsorName,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot SEPARATOR ', ') as slots,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.id ORDER BY m.id SEPARATOR ' | ') as meetingIds
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
GROUP BY m.attendeeId, m.sponsorId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY meetingCount DESC;
